page.title: Welcome
page.purpose: The first screen a stranger sees. It hands them a working agent in one step and defers every account, credential and provisioning decision until after the agent has already answered them.

priorities.statement: Whether this can be tried right now, without an account or a credential
What the agent will be able to do once it exists
That an external handle is available later and is not needed now

states.description: A single description field and one dominant action.
The description is being drafted into an agent; the field is locked and the action is busy.
The drafted agent is shown for confirmation before anything is written.
The description is too short to draft from; the message sits beside the field.
Drafting failed; the typed description is preserved and a retry is offered.
Drafting is unavailable; the field explains what still works locally.
The page's regions are resolving; each reports its own placeholder.
Nothing to show yet; the surface says so and offers the action that would fill it.
One region failed while the rest resolved; the failure is named and the page stays usable.
Content is from a cached read; its age is stated.

elements.name: Attach a phone number or iMessage later

claims.statement: Exactly one action visually dominates the first screen, and it is the one that produces an agent.
claims.rationale: A first screen offering an equal-weight choice converts worse than one that makes the recommended path obvious.

claims.statement: No sign-in, payment, or credential field is present before an agent has been drafted.
claims.rationale: The whole reason the in-app surface exists is that it can be tried in ten seconds.

claims.statement: The reader meets the description field before any mention of attaching an external handle.
A failed draft preserves the typed description verbatim and does not clear the field.
A drafted agent is presented for confirmation and nothing is written until the confirm action is used.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-008 requires assisted authoring to present before it writes.

claims.statement: Default, submitting, success and request-error are each perceivably different without reading the copy.
Every state renders with equivalent contrast and hierarchy in both themes.

regions.purpose: The drafted agent profile resolved from the description.
